title: Dragon feels his late father's presence on the ranch

tellings.quote: he's had experiences on the property where he's felt his father's presence,

plain: A man known as Bryant "Dragon" Arnold, who has spent time at Skinwalker Ranch, a property in Utah famous for reports of strange events, says he has felt his late father's presence there. The ranch's owner, Brandon Fugal, passes this on to Michels: "he's had experiences on the property where he's felt his father's presence." If true, it would add contact with the dead to the long list of odd things people report at the ranch.
